observations.fact: Right hand retains grip as gun raises/rolls after previous recoil.

limitations: Numerical body angles, opening angle, pivot interpretation and normalized phase timing are authored approximations, not camera calibration or extracted animation/bones.
Dark/silver gameplay appearance is motion evidence only; current W127 blue paint/UV are preserved.
Loader contact is represented by weapon lowering/rolling and an open hold; no visible loader, cases, rounds or support-hand IK is authored.
Partial reload footage with Kill Clip HUD; no verified active Outlaw comparison or base-duration/perk-speed certification.
Native visual framing, handedness and clearances remain master QA; source frames and offline renders do not prove native success.
